# Projects log

Estimate against actual for every delivered project. This is the evidence behind the rates in
`building-blocks.md`. One row per project phase; details in `knowledge/actuals/<slug>.md`.
A row with the word TEST in capitals (`<slug> (TEST)`, `TEST DATA.` in Notes) is test data: estimates never
count it as a delivered project.
